overall_quality.reason: Accurate, basic but correct explanation of virtual memory via paging/swapping; lacks detail on address translation, page tables, MMU but is usable.
overall_quality.evidence: Virtual memory is a system that allows a computer to use a combination of physical RAM and disk space to store and manage data. It works by temporarily moving data from RAM to disk when the system runs out of physical memory, and then moving it back when needed. This process is transparent to the user and helps to improve system performance by allowing more applications to run simultaneously.
